planning_horizon_hours: <int> Total length of the scheduling period in hours.

cost_parameters.fuel_price_usd_per_tonne: <int> Price of bunker fuel per metric tonne in US dollars.
cost_parameters.handling_cost_usd_per_hour: <int> Cost per hour of cargo handling at berth in US dollars.
cost_parameters.delay_cost_usd_per_hour: <int> Cost per hour of finishing after the expected finish time in US dollars.
cost_parameters.waiting_cost_usd_per_hour: <int> Cost per hour a ship waits at anchorage before berthing in US dollars.
cost_parameters.lft_penalty_usd: <int> Penalty in US dollars for each hour of finishing after the latest finish time.

handling_time_deviation_factor_beta_per_: <float> Rate at which handling time increases per meter of deviation from the ideal berthing position.

ports.quay_length_meters: <int> Total usable quay length at the port in meters.

distances_nautical_miles: <dict, key: '{origin_port}_{destination_port}'> Sailing distance in nautical miles between each ordered pair of ports.
speeds_knots: <list[float], length num_speeds> Set of discrete sailing speeds available to all ships in knots.
travel_time_hours_per_nm_by_speed: <dict, key: '{speed_knots}'> Hours required to sail one nautical mile at each available speed.

ships.type: <str> Ship size category (feeder, medium, or large).
ships.length_meters: <int> Overall length of the ship in meters.
ships.design_speed_knots: <float> Nominal cruising speed of the ship in knots.
ships.fuel_consumption_at_design_speed_tonnes_: <float> Daily fuel consumption when sailing at design speed in metric tonnes.
ships.fuel_consumption_per_nm_by_speed: <dict, key: '{speed_knots}'> Fuel consumed per nautical mile at each available sailing speed in metric tonnes.
ships.route: <list[str]> Ordered sequence of port identifiers the ship must visit.

port_visits.port_call_index: <int> Position of this visit in the ship's route sequence, starting from 1.
port_visits.port_id: <str> Identifier of the port being visited.
port_visits.ideal_berthing_position: <float> Preferred leftmost quay coordinate in meters where the ship should berth.
port_visits.min_handling_time_hours: <float> Minimum cargo handling duration in hours when berthed at the ideal position.
port_visits.max_handling_time_hours: <float> Maximum possible cargo handling duration in hours when berthed at the worst position.
port_visits.earliest_start_time_hours: <float> Earliest hour at which berthing may begin.
port_visits.expected_finish_time_hours: <float> Target departure hour equal to earliest start time plus minimum handling time.
port_visits.latest_finish_time_hours: <float> Latest acceptable departure hour before penalty costs apply.

external_ships.port_id: <str> Identifier of the port where these external ships are berthed.

ships.id: <int> Unique identifier of the external ship within this port.
ships.berthing_position: <float> Fixed leftmost quay coordinate in meters where the external ship is berthed.
ships.length_meters: <int> Overall length of the external ship in meters.
ships.start_time_hours: <float> Hour at which the external ship begins occupying the berth.
ships.handling_time_hours: <float> Duration in hours the external ship occupies the berth.
ships.end_time_hours: <float> Hour at which the external ship departs the berth.
